description: Memory system policy defining three memory types, their authority rules, and lifecycle gates.

memory_types.description: Working memory for the current run. Written during the run. Helps repair and context. Cannot certify or affect final status.
Candidate lessons and observations. Promoted to durable only through memory_write_gate.py after final status is locked.
Cross-run advisory memory. Written only after final status is locked. Advisory only — cannot replace evidence or influence certification.

authority_rules.description: Memory artifacts are excluded from evidence indexing. Memory paths must not appear in evidence_hash_manifest.json or evidence_freeze.json.
Memory can suggest, advise, and inform. Memory cannot certify DONE, write final_status.json, or override policy decisions.
Durable memory is written only after final_status.json is locked. The memory_write_gate.py enforces this delay.
Run-local memory is cleared or archived when the run transitions to DONE. It is never promoted to evidence.
